display_name: ONNX-ASR (misterkissi w2v2 lg xls r 300m fante)
description: Runs ASR models exported to ONNX through the onnx-asr library, without a PyTorch dependency. This fighter runs misterkissi-w2v2-lg-xls-r-300m-fante (wav2vec2-ctc), covering fat.
notes: Model from the OpenVoiceOS 'stt-asr-onnx' HuggingFace collection.
